$comment: Required-cases manifest (plan §7.2). Maps the §9 acceptance scenarios (E01-E15) to the REAL Go test names that prove them. Consumed by scripts/acceptance/verify-tests.py --required-cases. A listed test that does not run, or that is skipped, is a hard failure. NOTE: test names are filled in by T02 (contracts runners) and T09/T12; empty arrays below are placeholders, NOT a claim that the scenario passes.

scenarios.summary: normal path: two Anvil chains emit ERC20 logs; one verified Swap fixture
fork depth 1/2/12; same-height new hash; tx re-included
two-chain isolation: A rollback leaves B unchanged
commit-crash kill at boundaries + SIGTERM graceful shutdown
repair-job crash: DB rollback done, notify fails, restart resumes
finality failure: finalized/safe unavailable, stale, wrong chain
DB/MQ/Redis failure: backpressure, redelivery, no early ack
auth: nonce concurrency/expiry/address swap, bad origin/format
precision/decoding: signed/unsigned bounds, bad topics, unknown ABI
API compat + paging across cold/hot cache and reorg
mode equivalence: monolithic vs four-service canonical digest equal
deploy/rollback: bad image/config, prior digest restore
